meta.headline: Nuclear astrophysics and nucleosynthesis: citation network over the years
meta.dek: Topic 49 of the INSPIRE citation clustering (Nuclear structure and reactions), 7,908 papers, median year 2012. Shown: its 500 most cited papers, 100 of them with Latin American authors (the most cited of those come first, up to 20%); placed by year, every line is one paper citing another inside this set.
meta.foot: Source: data/ and out/clusters/ of restrepo/inspireauth10 (INSPIRE-HEP tables of 2026-11-09), made by reproduce/topics/timelines.py. 500 papers, 5237 citation links; 100 with Latin American authors (of 120 in the topic). Labels: the 15 most cited and the 20 most cited with Latin American authors. Citations are INSPIRE's totals.
